title: Arithmetic Operators and Integer Division
learningObjectives: Explain arithmetic operators and integer division in C++.
Identify the operators, operands and result types involved.
Predict an expression's result by tracing it.
Use the topic in a focused program.
Avoid common mistakes and choose a clear alternative.

understand.concept: Arithmetic uses +, -, *, / and integer % for calculations. Integer division truncates the fractional part; remainder needs integer operands and a nonzero divisor.
understand.whyItMatters: Accurate expression understanding prevents logic errors and improves safety, readability and maintainability.
understand.explain: Study arithmetic operators and integer division through the rule summary and examples; trace values carefully and note type and edge-case constraints.
